method.label: Find the ring's share of the area

annotationRationale: The method interprets the circular inequalities, verifies containment with a square identity, and computes uniform geometric probability using circle and triangle areas.
sourceMethod: Follows the official annulus-to-square area ratio. A nonnegative-square identity supplies the containment justification behind the official tangency observation.

review.mathCheck: The target is 18≤x²+y²≤32, with area 14π. The square identity proves containment in |x|+|y|≤8, whose area is 128. Hence the probability is 7π/64 and m+n=71, choice B. Included boundaries have zero area.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Originally worded, faithful adaptation of official AMC 10B #14, p. 7, using the same contained-annulus area ratio. The algebra supplies the official figure's tangency-based containment. The candidate correctly uses (0,8), despite the source diagram's mislabeled top vertex.
review.annotationCheck: Circle recognition and geometric probability are appropriately assessed. The square identity and circle/triangle areas are valid supporting knowledge; no point-to-line distance formula is used or needed.
